What's your return and refund policy?

Agent response: Our return and refund policy varies depending on the type of product. Here's a breakdown: For Soylent Food Products (meals and shakes): Soylent meals and shakes are food products and are generally not eligible for return or exchange after purchase due to food safety reasons. Once an order has been processed and shipped, it is considered a final sale. However, we do consider refund or replacement requests for products that have arrived damaged or defective. If your package was damaged in transit, please notify our Customer Care team within 5 days of delivery. For any other defective product, you must notify Soylent within 14 days of the delivery date. Eligible items must be unwashed, unused, unaltered, returned in their original packaging, and have garment tags intact. Soylent reserves the right to deny a return if the item does not comply with these conditions. Refunds will be processed back to the original method of payment, which typically takes 5-7 days to finish processing. Shipping and handling charges are not refundable, and customers are responsible for return shipping costs. Soylent cannot accept responsibility for returns lost or damaged in transit. For Products Purchased from Third-Party Resellers: Any Soylent product or merchandise purchased from a third-party reseller or retailer (either online or in-store) must be handled directly with that reseller or retailer, and their return/exchange policy will apply.
